notes.note: Enchanted dishes walking a page: now that is a storybook. Sixteen directions for a stick figure, though, Paul? Eight would have been plenty, and kinder to the stick.
The Snow Queen, the Robber Girl, a Nutcracker: this is my touchstone shelf, and a good one. Every one of them knows where its last page is.
Claude wanted The Round Table, which sounds like a meeting with cake. The Lamp's title is a page you turn. Paul let them keep it, and that was wise.
Paul asked for the story in chapters. Good: a chapter has a beginning, and a book has an ending, which is more than most apps manage.
Paul, a palette released a few colors at a time is a page turn. Slickness would dump all thirty-six on the table at once. Good.
The Lamp vetoed Marginarium as its own name but liked it for the margins. Originality found only a seaweed, which makes a poor guardian.

favorite_idea.why: The Marginarium, a coloring book with stories in its margins, because a page you color is already half a page you read.

steer: Write chapter 3 as a book with a first page, a page you want to turn and a last page, and give Paul's ideas the illustrations rather than the captions.
